api_enabled.description: Enable the ExaBGP API listener (for programmatic control)

api_host.description: IP address the API will bind to (prefer 127.0.0.1 for security)

api_port.description: TCP port for the API listener

api_tls_ca.description: Path to the CA certificate for client validation

api_tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS server certificate file

api_tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for the API (requires valid certificates)

api_tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file

bgp_local_address.description: Local IP address to bind the BGP session(s) to

bgp_local_as.description: Autonomous System Number (ASN) of this BGP speaker (32-bit or 16-bit)

bgp_peers.description: List of BGP peers to establish sessions with

add_paths.description: Enable BGP ADD-PATHs (send multiple paths for same prefix)

address.description: IP address of the BGP peer (IPv4 or IPv6)

auth_key.description: MD5 password for peer authentication (leave empty to disable)

connect_retry.description: Time in seconds before retrying a failed connection

hold_time.description: BGP hold timer in seconds (0 = disable)

inbound_filter.description: Name of an inbound route filter script or predefined filter (e.g., 'inbound-filter-v4')

keepalive.description: Keepalive interval in seconds (must be ≤ hold_time/3)

outbound_filter.description: Name of an outbound route filter script or predefined filter

bgp_router_id.description: IPv4 router-id for the BGP speaker (must be unique per AS)

process_env.description: Environment variables for the hook process (e.g., webhook URLs, tokens)
